exchanges.body: Harold Biggs. I hit a deer last night on 2484 near Salado. The front's smashed and it's leaking coolant. Is that collision or what? I've got five hundred on comprehensive and a thousand on collision.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: I'm sorry, Mr. Biggs. Are you all right? I have your claim, LR-26-118344, and this call confirms we've received it. Hitting a deer is covered under your comprehensive coverage, so the five-hundred-dollar deductible applies, not the collision deductible.

exchanges.author: c_biggs
exchanges.body: I'm fine. It's in my driveway and it won't drive. What now?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Choose any shop you like. If you'd like, Belton Collision can tow it in and write the estimate with our appraiser. Your policy has transportation expense, thirty dollars a day up to nine hundred, starting 24 hours after the loss, so you can rent a car now. I'll email you what we need today.

exchanges.author: c_biggs
exchanges.body: Belton's fine. Thanks.

exchanges.author: worker

Comprehensive applies, $500 deductible (not the $1,000 collision deductible). Insured chose Belton Collision (DRP) to tow and estimate. Transportation expense $30/day, $900 max, from 24 hours after the loss. Written acknowledgment and item list to follow.
